BOOKING_CONFIRMED.title: Booking Confirmed! ✅
BOOKING_CONFIRMED.body: Your booking at {venueName} for {date} at {time} is confirmed. Booking Code: {bookingCode}

NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST.title: New Booking Received! 📋
NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST.body: New booking received for {venueName} on {date} at {time} by {customerName}. Code: {bookingCode}

MATCH_REMINDER_KICKOFF.title: 2 Hours Until Kickoff! ⏳
MATCH_REMINDER_KICKOFF.body: Your match at {venueName} starts at {time}. Gate Pass Code: {bookingCode} 🎫

MATCH_REMINDER_MORNING.title: Match Day Today! ⚽
MATCH_REMINDER_MORNING.body: Your match at {venueName} kicks off at {time}. Get ready with your team! 🏆

MATCH_REMINDER_CANCELLED.title: Match Reminder Cancelled ❌
MATCH_REMINDER_CANCELLED.body: Your booking at {venueName} has been cancelled or rescheduled.

NEW_PROMO.title: New Special Offer! 🎁
NEW_PROMO.body: {promoTitle} - Book now and enjoy special discounts on your favorite pitches!

NEW_COUPON.title: New Discount Code! 🏷️
NEW_COUPON.body: Use coupon code {couponCode} to get a {discount} discount on your next booking!

PAYMENT_APPROVED.title: Payment Approved! 💳
PAYMENT_APPROVED.body: Your payment for booking #{bookingCode} has been verified and approved.

PAYMENT_REJECTED.title: Payment Rejected ⚠️
PAYMENT_REJECTED.body: Your payment screenshot for booking #{bookingCode} was rejected. {reason}

USER_SUSPENDED.title: Account Status Notice ⚠️
USER_SUSPENDED.body: Hello {userName}, your account has been suspended. Reason: {reason}

USER_ON_HOLD.title: Account Under Review ℹ️
USER_ON_HOLD.body: Hello {userName}, your account is on hold. Reason: {reason}

USER_ACTIVE.title: Account Activated! 🟢
USER_ACTIVE.body: Welcome back {userName}, your account has been activated. You can now book pitches.

PITCH_REOPENED.title: Pitch Reopened! 🏟️
PITCH_REOPENED.body: {venueName} is back open and ready for bookings after maintenance.
